name: Exact
tagline: Write an app once and run it natively on web, macOS, iOS, and Linux
description: Exact is an open‑source cross‑platform application runtime. Developers describe the UI in a small declarative language called Contract and write data logic in TypeScript or Rust. The Contract compiler produces a compact plan that runs on the web as a lightweight ES module and on macOS, iOS, and Linux via a Rust runner that renders with native toolkits. The framework is designed for AI agents to build, run, test, and verify apps across all supported hosts without human intervention.
best_for: Prototyping UI with a single codebase
Building apps that can be tested by AI agents
Creating apps for web, macOS, iOS, and Linux simultaneously
Open‑source projects needing a Rust‑based runtime
